## Improvements

- Export Instagram cards in light or dark mode independently of Obsidian’s appearance.
- Use a fixed global font size based on the selected theme’s typography, with individual slide overrides and a reset to the global size.
- Keep slide font sizes separately for each note and automatically follow the active Markdown note, including when switching between open notes.
- Place each slide’s font size control above its preview.

## Fixes

- Keep the exported layout consistent when resizing the converter sidebar.
- Preserve scroll position and input focus when changing font sizes, including when pressing Enter on later slides.
- Allow mouse-wheel scrolling over preview images.
- Fit embedded images and PDF pages proportionally into the space around the text, without clipping them inside fixed embed containers.
- Warn when text exceeds the slide instead of automatically shrinking it.
- Ignore stale reads when switching notes quickly.

## Validation

Build, lint, and browser regression tests cover theme selection, PNG output, media fitting, note switching, and native mouse-wheel and Enter-key interactions. The existing advisory about Obsidian’s newer settings-search API remains unchanged.

## Installation

Update through BRAT, or copy `main.js`, `manifest.json`, and `styles.css` into your vault’s `.obsidian/plugins/social-converter/` folder and reload the plugin. Requires Obsidian 1.7.2 or later.
